daily_run_state_machine.LOCK_ACQUIRED: fcntl.flock exclusive on audit/change-queue/.daily-run.lock; if held → RUN_SKIPPED_DOUBLE (exit 2, NO queue/alert/digest writes) — boundary K
daily_run_state_machine.SOURCES_SELECTED: registry brands with next_retry_at ≤ now (offline replay: fixture source set); each source independent (§77 partial_success — one failure never fails the run)
daily_run_state_machine.ACQUIRE: offline = committed artifact replay (tests/fixtures/oem-artifacts + tmp fixtures from AcquisitionWriter); live = Writer.write gated, registry URLs only
daily_run_state_machine.PROVENANCE_VERIFY: AcquisitionReader.read — hash mismatch/missing sidecar → ProvenanceError → source RUN_FAILED_PROVENANCE (no classify, no candidate, no alert for that source) — boundary I; LEGACY_UNVERIFIED fixtures recorded, never semantically processed as verified — boundary contract 3
daily_run_state_machine.DIFF_CLASSIFY: classify_capture → UNCHANGED | CONTENT_CHANGED_OUTPUT_UNCHANGED | CHANGED — boundaries A/B/C/J
daily_run_state_machine.QUARANTINE: CHANGED → field-level candidate appended (status QUARANTINED, old_sha/new_sha/source/entity/field) — idempotent by candidate_id — boundary C; model/variant set diffs → candidates + alerts (E)
daily_run_state_machine.ALERT_EVAL: §94 allowlist only (tracked price change, model/variant add/remove, new conflict, provenance/hash failure, reachable→blocked transition, promotion-gate failure) with dedupe by event_id — boundaries D/F/O
daily_run_state_machine.PRESERVE_ACCEPTED: failed/blocked source → run-state keeps previous accepted values untouched; catalog tables never opened — boundary M (asserted by table-count invariance)
daily_run_state_machine.DIGEST: MD+JSON with run_id, exact SHA, artifact count+bytes, per-OEM identity levels (registry axes + staging identity counters), hash coverage, locator coverage, tests/blockers, candidates, alerts, state transitions — boundary N
daily_run_state_machine.RUN_GREEN | RUN_PARTIAL | RUN_FAILED: green = every selected source reached a terminal §94 state; partial = some failed but run completed (§77); failed = runner-level error; digest written in all three
